source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 23. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Right for good and clean things, left for unclean things

learn.en: Use your right hand to take and give things, to eat and drink, and to shake hands.
learn.title: Right hand for good things

learn.en: Start with the right when putting on shoes and clothes. Enter the mosque with your right foot.
learn.title: Right side first

learn.en: Use the left hand for unclean things: blowing your nose, cleaning yourself in the toilet, washing away dirt.
learn.title: Left hand for unclean things

learn.en: Don't walk around wearing only one shoe or sandal!
learn.title: Two shoes, please

learn.en: Enter the toilet with the left foot, and leave it with the right foot.
learn.title: The toilet

quiz.en: I enter the toilet with my ___ foot.
I enter the masjid with my ___ foot.
True or false? It's fine to walk around wearing only one shoe.

think.q: Tomorrow morning, can you put on your shoes starting with the right foot?
think.a: Yes — right shoe first, then the left!

parents.summary: Right hand and right side for good things (eating, giving, shoes, entering the mosque); left for unclean tasks.
parents.tip: At meals, gently remind him: right hand.
